author: Mark Atwood
text: Escalating to human together with JMAP-x2gd.4 — same workspace-architectural shape. See JMAP-x2gd.4 most recent comment for the full options-and-recommendation writeup. Briefly: Path A (typed methods on ChatBackend) is my recommendation; Paths B (apply_space_patch variants) and C (may_* hook + generic create_object re-check) are also plausible but have wire-shape / type-erasure drawbacks respectively. Both .3 and .4 should be done together to avoid divergent patterns for the same kind of gate.
